snippet.title: MINDFUNK In 13 Days - VAINSANE Fridays #4
snippet.description:
VAINSANE Fridays #4 — MINDFUNK In 13 Days

Help Nari and Sena make sense of a cringeworthy drink called MINDFUNK that predicts their death. Your choices in this psychological horror visual novel will determine how they deal with this MIND****.

Part of VAINSANE Fridays, where I release a new bite-sized horror game every other Friday. Releasing on April 24, 2026.

Buy on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4572680/MINDFUNK_In_13_Days/
